Standard: Control surface installation is designed to limit and constrain motion to within the actuator range of travel. Control surface mechanical stop is capable of withstanding maximum loads including the effects of mis-rigging. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review actuator installation drawings.
(2) Review control surface mechanical stop design. Analysis.
  (1) Analyze mechanical stop design for maximum force and rate impact.
